Hi team,

Thanks for flagging. Finance guidance below — high level first, then operational asks.

High-level recommendation:
- Issue a customer-specific credit memo for $12,500 and apply it to the July invoice. This keeps the customer's ledger clean and avoids creating a negative cash event.
- GLA mapping: map the credit memo to revenue contra account 4025-RED (promo allowances). We will then post a journal entry to move the promotional allowance to the proper month-end accrual account.
- No PO amendment required on our side; if Acero prefers not to change their PO, applying the credit to the invoice is acceptable (we'll record as 'contractual allowance').

Operational items needed from Sales/Account Team:
1) Internal approval from Sales leadership to issue credit (Jonas please confirm authorization).
2) Confirmation of the exact invoice id to apply the credit against (Maria listed invoice_0715_acero.pdf — please confirm invoice number).
3) Customer billing contact (billing@acerohealth.com) confirmation that they accept credit memo application vs. separate credit note.

I've attached a draft credit memo for review (activation_stipend_credit_memo_draft.pdf) — it includes suggested narrative and accounting fields. Once Sales approves, Finance will: prepare the final credit memo PDF, post the journal entry, and apply the credit in the billing system. Expected timeline: 48 hours after approval, subject to cutoffs.

If anyone wants the GL transaction lines up front I can paste them here.

—Neha
